resume: Where to look for a place, which documents to prepare for the daycare (crèche) application, and how to get help from the Caf (CMG) when you employ a registered childminder (assistante maternelle).
aQuoiCaSert: Having your young child looked after lets you work or train. Daycare (crèche) places should be requested early, often during pregnancy. If you employ a registered childminder (assistante maternelle agréée), the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office), or the MSA (Mutualité sociale agricole, the farmers' social security fund), can pay the complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG, childcare allowance) and cover the social security contributions. Having a complete file from your very first request avoids losing your place on the waiting list.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of a child under 6 (up to the child's 12th birthday for a single parent, for the direct-employment CMG).

As a couple, at least one parent must work to receive the CMG. Treated as work: paid sick or maternity leave, paid unemployment, paid training. Some situations exempt you: studies, civic service (service civique), AAH (adult disability allowance), RSA (minimum income) with registration as a job seeker, ASS (solidarity allowance for job seekers).
aSavoir: Public daycare: the application is usually submitted to the early childhood department of the town hall (mairie) or of the group of towns (intercommunalité). Non-profit or private daycare: you register with the management. It is advisable to start during pregnancy.
In daycares funded by the Caf, the hourly rate follows a national scale set by the Cnaf (the national family benefits fund), based on your income and the number of dependent children.

Childminders must be registered (agréées) by the PMI service (protection maternelle et infantile, the mother and child health service) of the conseil départemental (département council). You become their employer and sign an employment contract.

CMG: the amount depends on your income, the number of children, the hourly cost of childcare (capped) and the number of hours. Contributions are covered 100% for a registered childminder, up to a monthly ceiling.
Shared residence: since December 1, 2025, each parent can receive the CMG, calculated according to their own situation. It is not a split of the amount.
You must register on Pajemploi and declare the salary paid each month. The Pajemploi+ option lets the center debit and pay the salary, with your employee's agreement.

documents.detail: Copy. During pregnancy, a certificate of pregnancy is usually requested instead. Birth certificate free on service-public.gouv.fr.

documents.libelle: Proof of address less than 3 months old
documents.detail: Copy. Municipal daycares often reserve places for residents of the town.

documents.libelle: Latest tax notice or Caf beneficiary number
documents.detail: Copy. Used to calculate the daycare's hourly rate.
Employment contract, payslips, certificate of training or from France Travail (the public employment service), depending on the case.

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement setting residence and parental authority, if you are separated
documents.detail: Copy. Shows who may pick up the child and each parent's weeks.

documents.libelle: Vaccination pages of the health record book
documents.detail: Copy. The vaccines compulsory for the child's age are required to start daycare, unless there is a contraindication.

The childminder's employment contract and certificate of registration
documents.detail: Original signed by both parties. Ask for a copy of the registration issued by the PMI.
For the daycare's direct debit or the payment of the CMG.

etapes.titre: Look for childcare options near you
etapes.detail: On monenfant.fr (the website of the family benefits branch), through a relais petite enfance (RPE, early childhood information center) or at the town hall.

Family record book or certificate of pregnancy, parents' ID, proof of address less than 3 months old, tax notice or Caf number, proof of activity, judgment if you are separated, vaccination pages. Ask the daycare for its exact list.
With the town hall's early childhood department for a public daycare, otherwise with the management. Note the date you applied and follow up regularly.

etapes.titre: With a childminder, check their registration and sign the contract
etapes.detail: Registration issued by the PMI of the conseil départemental.

In your Caf (or MSA) online account, childcare section, as soon as childcare starts. Not yet a beneficiary? First create an account. Then register as an employer on Pajemploi and declare the salary each month.
In the Journal, to track the expense per child and the split with the other parent.
